full_judgment: 5. The petitioner files an application for revision under section 115(2) C.P.C. being Civil Revision No. 143/82 before the District Judge, Noakhali who by his order dated 13-5-84 rejected the Civil Revision case with the observation that the learned Subordinate Judge committed no illegality in allowing the application under section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure for ends of justice. This Rule is obtained by the proforma-defendant-petitioner against the order of the learned District Judge.
